Commentary.Commentary: ...THIRD INNINGS....

Kraigg Brathwaite had a small word with his group before start of the innings, however, it didn't work out at all. West Indies had to show a lot of application on this kind of pitch but they failed massively. All of them were victims of the spin. If not for Motie, Seales and Warrican, they would have given away a lead of more than 100 but they are still well behind in the game right now. Their spinners need to learn from Khan and Ali, if bowled well they could make some early inroads. Can they? Join us after TEA for the final session.

All out inside a session! That innings from Seales and Warrican have helped West Indies cut the deficit under 100 but it was Sajid Khan and Noman Ali show for the hosts. The duo were expected to take matters onto themselves and they did dearly. Both shared 9 wickets, Sajid Khan troubled the top order while Ali came in handy to get better of the middle order of the Windies. Apart from that counter attack from the tail enders, it was all Pakistan through and through.
OUT! GONE! That's it! Flighted full and around off. Seales looks to slog-sweep but top edges it to cover. The keeper, Mohammad Rizwan calls for it and collects. West Indies are bowled out for 137.

Commentary.Commentary: Kavem Hodge to face the hat trick ball.

OUT! GONE! The inexperienced has started to show up! Flat and well outside off, spins in sharply. Carty goes back to flick but edges it to the right of short leg. Muhammad Hurraira flies at that side and catches it brilliantly. Sharp reflexes from the debutant.
Commentary.Howout: c Muhammad Hurraira b Sajid Khan
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Sajid Khan to Keacy Carty, OUT! c Muhammad Hurraira b Sajid Khan.

Commentary.Commentary: Keacy Carty walks in.

OUT! BOWLED!  Sajid Khan means business. There comes his celebration. A slap on the thighs and a finger up! Flighted full and outside off, spins in sharply and goes through the gate as Mikyle Louis tries to defend across, he misses and it crashes the stumps.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Sajid Khan to Mikyle Louis, OUT! b Sajid Khan.
